claims.claim: The 2014 quantitative genre study by Nichols, Lynn and Purzycki, the only quantitative science-fiction item Google Scholar surfaces beside Wolfe's name, does not contain Gene Wolfe in its corpus: the word Wolfe does not occur in the draft.
claims.source: Ryan Nichols, Justin Lynn & Benjamin Grant Purzycki, Scientific Study of Literature 4:1 (2014), author-hosted draft
